mentions.name: Dozenal
mentions.description: A puzzle game played with numbers on a board where the gap between two numbers dictates the arithmetic operation applied to them. The goal is to use all the spaces on the board to make sums of 12.
mentions.source_excerpt:
https://dozenal.game

It's a puzzle game -- numbers on a board -- where the gap between numbers dictates the arithmetic operation done to them.

The goal is to use all the spaces on the board to make sums of 12.
mentions.author: sarreph

mentions.name: Dozenal
mentions.description: A daily puzzle game where players solve each puzzle board by creating chains totalling the number 12. The idea originated with the builder and a friend over a decade ago and has been in development for the past couple of months.
mentions.source_excerpt: A daily puzzle game called Dozenal where you solve each puzzle board by creating chains totalling the number 12.

mentions.description: A daily number puzzle game called Dozenal, playable at its website; the builders have been growing its user base over the past couple of months while refining the learning curve.
mentions.audience: People who enjoy number puzzle games.
mentions.source_excerpt:
https://dozenal.game

A daily puzzle game called Dozenal that I've been making with a friend. We've been increasing our user base over the past couple of months and are still trying to refine the learning curve.

If you like number puzzle games, I would be very keen for you to give it a go and to hear your feedback on it!
